# Final-round loop: Senior Backend Engineer, week of 26 Oct 2026

## 1. Schedules

**UTC offsets that week**

| City | Offset | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Berlin | CET, UTC+1 | EU clocks went back on Sun 25 Oct. |
| Lisbon | WET, UTC+0 | Portugal changed on the same date as the EU. |
| New York | EDT, UTC−4 | US clocks don't change until Sun 1 Nov. |
| Chicago | CDT, UTC−5 | Same US rule as New York. |

Berlin and New York are 5 hours apart this week, not the usual 6.

### Richard Miles (Chicago): Tue 27 Oct 2026 (30-minute breaks)

| Session | Interviewer | UTC | Miles (CDT) | Interviewer local |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| System design | Jane Doe | 14:15–15:00 | 09:15–10:00 | 15:15–16:00 CET |
| Hiring manager | John Stiles | 15:30–16:15 | 10:30–11:15 | 11:30–12:15 EDT |
| Coding | Mary Major | 16:45–17:30 | 11:45–12:30 | 12:45–13:30 EDT |

### Richard Roe (Lisbon): Wed 28 Oct 2026 (15- and 30-minute breaks)

| Session | Interviewer | UTC | Roe (WET) | Interviewer local |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| System design | Jane Doe | 13:30–14:15 | 13:30–14:15 | 14:30–15:15 CET |
| Coding | Mary Major | 14:30–15:15 | 14:30–15:15 | 10:30–11:15 EDT |
| Hiring manager | John Stiles | 15:45–16:30 | 15:45–16:30 | 11:45–12:30 EDT |

## 2. Why these days and slots

- **Miles must be Tue 27.** He is only free Tue or Thu, and Jane is out of office on Thu.
- **Roe must be Wed 28.** Each interviewer can do only one final-round session per day, and Miles uses all three on Tuesday.
- **Working-hours overlap.** Jane's day is 08:00–16:00 UTC and the New York interviewers' is 13:00–21:00 UTC. John's standup blocks 13:00–13:30 UTC.
- **Miles's Tuesday is the tight day.**
  - Jane's busy block (13:00–15:00 Berlin) runs to 14:00 UTC, and her day ends at 16:00 UTC. Her session therefore has to sit in 14:00–16:00 UTC.
  - Mary is busy 15:00–16:00 UTC (11:00–12:00 New York).
  - With 30-minute breaks the loop spans 3h15.
- **Options I ruled out for Miles:**
  - Jane at 14:00 UTC starts the moment her meeting ends, so I added a 15-minute buffer.
  - Jane at 15:15–16:00 UTC ends exactly at 17:00 Berlin with no slack.
  - Mary in the middle slot (about 15:30 UTC) clashes with her 15:00–16:00 UTC block. Mary goes last.
- **Roe's Wednesday.** Everyone is free, and Roe's day (09:00–17:00 UTC) overlaps the NY interviewers from 13:00 UTC. I started at 13:30 UTC so John's standup and Jane's 16:00 UTC cutoff leave comfortable margins. Roe has no accommodations, so breaks are 15 and 30 minutes.
